title: LuauNotes Knowledge Entry
description: Schema for a single knowledge entry in the LuauNotes knowledge base. Each entry lives in knowledge/<category>/<id>.json. The validator in app/lib/validate.js enforces these rules (and a few extras such as cross-link integrity) before content is accepted into the library.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match the file name (without .json) and be unique across the whole library.

category.description: Top-level library section. Drives sidebar grouping and validation rules.

type.description: What kind of thing this entry describes. Independent of category.

summary.description: One or two sentence summary shown in search results, cards, and lists.

keywords.description: Search phrases / synonyms that should strongly match this entry (e.g. 'player parameter' on OnServerEvent).

tags.description: Short lowercase labels used for filtering and discovery.

status.description: verified = checked against the cited source. review = believed correct, needs a verification pass. pending = unreviewed proposal (e.g. AI-generated) — always shown with a warning badge.

source.description: Authoritative source name, e.g. 'Roblox Creator Documentation'.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the authoritative documentation. Required for verified Roblox API entries (services/classes/methods/events/properties/datatypes).

lastVerified.description: Date the entry was last checked against the source.

verification.description: Provenance and verification metadata. NEVER present unverified information as verified.

replacement.description: API or approach to use instead.

deprecated.description: Deprecation state. Present only when meaningful.

reference.description: Precise technical facts: signatures, parameters, members, behavior. This is the 'verified reference' layer.

returns.description: Return value description (may contain backticked code).

details.description: Extra technical notes: replication, limits, restrictions, thread behavior.

explanation.description: The teaching layer: human-friendly, beginner-accessible. May simplify — must never contradict the reference layer.

related.description: IDs of related entries. Validated: every ID must exist in the library.

puzzles.description: Optional learning puzzles attached to this entry (future DukeOTR feature).

added.description: Date the entry was added to the library.
